caption:
Every lead sitting in your inbox has a dollar value attached to it, calculated or not.

The Missed Revenue Calculator does the math for you. Enter your monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and typical response time, and it models your revenue per lead, your monthly revenue, and the follow-up gap shrinking both.

Four numbers in. Real output out. No signup, no card, takes less time than your last missed call.

rationale: Offers/Lead Magnets is this cycle's under-served slot, and the Revenue Calculator is next in the tool rotation after the Ad ROI Calculator, shown as the single-offer promo card format built for one clear ask.
